description: Human-maintained engine ownership metadata. integration/codex/assembly.json and inventory/downstream.json are generated from this file, the ordered patches in integration/codex/patches, and the overlay source bytes; run `just engine-manifest` after changing any of them. Owner, purpose and regression groups come from the patch or overlay-root defaults below, with per-path overrides for deviations. Overlay membership, deletes, baseline identities and retired history are inputs held here. Patch paths and deletions are read from each patch's git diff headers; overlay sha256 and mode are read from source bytes. Historical source/upstream_source hashes for paths in the baseline diff are carried forward from the committed inventory.
